bilder.prompt:
A character reference sheet on warm white paper: the following people standing side by side in a row, full figure, front view, evenly spaced with white space between them, same scale, neutral standing pose, each face clearly visible. From left to right: Mary, Jesus, the master of the feast, the bridegroom, one male and one female servant, two disciples. No names, no lettering.

PEOPLE:
- Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.
- Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.
- The master of the feast: a portly older man, grey beard, receding grey hair, bare-headed, in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre-gold belt.
- The bridegroom: a young beardless or lightly bearded man in a muted violet festive robe with a wreath of small fresh flowers on his head.
- The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.
- The disciples: a few young and middle-aged men with beards in plain ochre and brown belted robes, bare-headed, staying close to Jesus.

STYLE (match the drawing style of the attached reference image only – its line, wash, palette and white space; ignore its content, layout, ages and text): Minimalist watercolour comic illustration for adults: warm white paper with lots of empty white space; very few thin, slightly irregular, deliberately broken ink lines, contours only where they clarify the form; diffuse, transparent watercolour washes with soft edges and visible paper; small warm muted palette of sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive and soft ink grey; natural adult proportions and faces with restrained expressions, emotion shown through gaze, posture and gesture; backgrounds only hinted. No stone textures, no detailed folds, no decorative hatching, no glossy or cinematic light, no photorealism, no anime eyes. Historically plausible first-century Galilee and Judea: simple woven garments, sandals, earthenware, stone. Light only from daylight or small clay oil lamps.
